description: Saves a message as a draft for inbox review without sending it. threadId drafts a reply on that thread or updates a saved draft conversation; connectedAccountId plus recipients creates a new draft conversation, including for recipients that already have one. recipients are email addresses or one chat handle. subject, cc and bcc are supported for email only; recipients: [] allows a Cc-only or Bcc-only email with at least one cc or bcc address. Explicit recipients also set the reply To. Saving on a threadId replaces that thread's one draft. The enabled account signature is appended at send time. Email drafts can carry files through fileIds (file values, a record's files list, or an upload made without recordId); omitting fileIds keeps the draft's files, [] removes them, and changed files produce a new revision. Returns draftMessageId, draftRevision and threadId, which identify the draft for a later send or discard. Nothing is sent.

body.description: Email drafts use Markdown; chat drafts use plain text

connectedAccountId.description: New outbound draft: the connected account to send from later. Required when threadId is omitted

fileIds.description: Email drafts only: files to attach, from a file value, a record's files list or an upload without recordId. Replaces the draft's attachments; omit to keep them, [] removes them

recipients.description: Primary recipients to preserve with the draft. Required when threadId is omitted; use [] for Cc-only or Bcc-only email

threadId.description: Reply draft: the existing thread to draft on. Omit to draft a brand-new outbound conversation

workspace.description: Slug or id of the workspace to work in. Optional when the account has exactly one usable workspace; required when it has several. An API key always works in its own workspace.

name: save_message_draft
title: Save message draft
